name: The new dishwasher
prompt: The new dishwasher doesn't know where anything goes. The bus tubs are stacking up by the pit.

outcome.told: The tubs stack up until the owner sees them and shows him herself.

choices.text: Show him the racks between tickets

outcome.told: Within the hour he has the racks going in the right order. He thanks you on his way out.

failure.told: Your tickets back up while you're at the pit. The owner asks what you're doing off the line.
